name: Matte fade
summary: A grade that lifts the black point to a grey and lowers contrast, so that the photo looks soft and printed.
how: Raise the black point of the tone curve to 8% to 15% grey.
Lower contrast by 10% to 20% and saturation by 20% to 40%.
Tint the shadows toward pink, green or teal by a small amount.

origin.note: Expired and cross-processed film gives lifted blacks and tinted shadows in zine photos of the 1990s.

adoptions.via: Tumblr blogs reblog faded, pastel-tinted photos with lifted blacks and grain.
VSCO presets bring the matte lifted-black grade to phone photos.
